## Regions Served
- **Gulf (GCC) Countries**: United Arab Emirates (Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, Ajman), Saudi Arabia (Riyadh, Jeddah, Dammam), Qatar (Doha), Kuwait (Kuwait City), Oman (Muscat), Bahrain (Manama). Full RTL Arabic UI and regional payment gateway support (Telr, Tap, Moyasar, Stripe).

- **Global Remote**: Singapore, United Kingdom (UK), United States (USA), Canada, Australia, Germany, Malaysia, and worldwide.

## Engagement Models (Low to High Budget)
1. **Starter (Individuals & Small Businesses)**: Affordable SEO websites, landing pages, clinic/shop sites, WhatsApp customer alerts, Flutter/Android bug fixes, and Play Store / App Store publishing (5–10 days).
2. **Growth (Startups & SMEs)**: Cross-platform Flutter (iOS & Android) MVPs, web admin dashboards, REST APIs, and turnkey white-label taxi, delivery, turf booking, or e-commerce apps (2–4 weeks).
3. **Enterprise (Companies & Agencies)**: High-concurrency microservices (.NET Core 8, Go, FastAPI, Node.js), MQTT IoT fleet telemetry, PostgreSQL 16, AI/RAG pipelines (pgvector, n8n, Dify), and dedicated monthly retainers.

## Core Technical Stack
- **Mobile**: Flutter (Riverpod, BLoC, Hive, Isar DB), Native Android (Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Java, Hilt, Room), iOS.
- **Backend & Cloud**: C# .NET Core 8, Go 1.22+, Python FastAPI, Node.js, MQTT (TLS QoS 1), WebSockets, PostgreSQL 16, MongoDB, Redis, Docker, Azure, CI/CD.
- **AI & Automation**: LLM APIs (Gemini, OpenAI), pgvector RAG, On-Device Gemini Nano & ONNX Runtime, WhatsApp Business Cloud API, n8n, Dify.
